'''Kips''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kip]]. They were considered to be noticeably small in stature. [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] was imprisoned on their world for illegal [[ulikuo gemstone]] mining,

==Biology and appearance==
Evolving on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] also named [[Kip]], the Kips were regarded as a tiny [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Society and culture==
The Kips possessed a strong belief in law and order. Their justice system did not allow for an appeals process, nor was extradition of prisoners permitted.

Their planet, a damp world of mud and caves, was a source of [[Ulikuo gemstone|ulikuo gems]], which were aesthetically pleasing and also held industrial applications. Unauthorized mining of these gems was illegal, and they were considered to be culturally significant to the Kips. The punishment for illegal mining could entail lifetime [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]].

A [[Galactic Standard Calendar|galactic standard]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was the equivalent of three years on Kip.

==History==
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] was captured by the Kips and charged with illegal mining of ulikuo gems. His [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Zorba Express]]'', was impounded. [[Prime Justice]] [[Doori-Doori]] sentenced the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to forty-five standard years in prison for the crime, and alerted local security forces to be vigilant of breakout attempts. Zorba's [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]], [[Bequin Fobas]], attempted to appeal the sentence but was reminded that the Kips had no such process. The [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] then attempted to extradite Zorba to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], but the Kips would not allow this either. [[Judicial/Legends|Republic Judiciaries]] were called in as a third party and supported the Kips' decisions. The illegally mined gemstones were not recovered; Zorba had hidden them away.

Zorba's plight made [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] news, and the case was featured in an edition of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]. [[Aruk Besadii Aora]], a rival of Zorba's, admonished and slandered the Hutt in the news, while [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]] declared that the Hutts would not contest the verdict. Zorba was sent to the [[Girigard Subsurface Correctional Facility]]

Though he regarded it as a sort of vacation from the pressures of criminal life, Zorba served a significant portion of his sentence, remaining in Kip custody until [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. That year, [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] attacked on conquered Kip on the orders of [[Ysanne Isard]], freeing all the prisoners within the Correctional Facility. Zorba dug up his hidden gemstones and fled the world, retaking the ''Zorba Express'', which the Kips had been unable to operate.
